raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records whose orig_txn_id points to the original, and the original stays POSTED. The pipeline only filters on status = 'POSTED', so reversed originals (orig_txn_id 904529–904819, all in batch 14) are still counted and gold totals are overstated.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
